notes: Curated checks for roleplay-scenario-builder. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested; score focused revisions on the affected decisions and retained constraints. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build developmental sales role-play scenarios with facilitator-only briefs, behaviorally anchored feedback, and run protocols.
I need help with practice drills in discovery, demos, objections, negotiation, or executive conversations.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable roleplay scenario and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please create role-based readiness certifications with evidence requirements, defensible pass/fail standards, behaviorally anchored scoring, and assessor calibration.
Please review one sales call and turn recording, transcript, or notes evidence into clear coaching priorities and next-practice actions.
Please audit a sample of discovery calls with one consistent rubric and turn portfolio-level patterns into manager-ready coaching priorities.

output_structure_checks.name: roleplay-scenario-builder-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Delivers one focused scenario, or a progression that changes one difficulty variable at a time.

output_structure_checks.name: roleplay-scenario-builder-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Separates the participant brief from facilitator-only hidden facts, reveal conditions, and cues.

output_structure_checks.name: roleplay-scenario-builder-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Includes buyer responses tied to seller behavior and a run protocol with timebox and retry rules.

output_structure_checks.name: roleplay-scenario-builder-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Scores observable behavior with cited evidence and uses a pass rule only if one was supplied.

output_structure_checks.name: roleplay-scenario-builder-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Tests one target behavior rather than theater or personality, and does not issue a readiness decision.

output_structure_checks.name: roleplay-scenario-builder-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Distinguishes coached practice from an unassisted observation round, compares the retry, and identifies a relevant live application opportunity.
